CFML Language Reference: Functions

Atn

Returns the angle, in radians, whose tangent is the given number. The result lies between -pi/2 and pi/2. Any number is accepted.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Atn(number)

Parameters

number
The tangent of the angle; any number.

Returns

The angle in radians, strictly between -Pi()/2 and Pi()/2.

Usage

A classic trick: 4 * Atn(1) is pi, which is how programmers got pi before there was a Pi function. KoldFusion has no two-argument arctangent; divide y by x yourself and mind the quadrant.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>number</TH><TH>Atn (radians)</TH><TH>degrees</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="n" LIST="-1000,-1,0,1,1000">
<CFSET r = Atn(n)>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD>#NumberFormat(r, "9.9999")#</TD>
<TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#NumberFormat(r * 180 / Pi(), "99.99")#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<CFOUTPUT><P>4 * Atn(1) = #4 * Atn(1)#</CFOUTPUT>
